import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Simple approach: use top 3 features by t-statistic
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] != 'derived':
            # Calculate t-statistic manually
            group0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
            group1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
            n0, n1 = len(group0), len(group1)
            if n0 > 0 and n1 > 0:
                mean0, mean1 = np.mean(group0), np.mean(group1)
                var0, var1 = np.var(group0), np.var(group1)
                se = np.sqrt(var0/n0 + var1/n1)
                t_stat = (mean1 - mean0) / (se + 1e-8)
                t_stats.append((fid, abs(t_stat)))
    
    # Sort by t-statistic and take top 3
    t_stats.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    drivers = tuple(fid for fid, _ in t_stats[:3])
    
    # All non-derived features for regression
    columns = tuple(f for f in feats.ids if feats.types[feats.column(f)] != 'derived')
    
    # No interactions for simplicity
    products = ()
    
    # Simple weighting
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in drivers}
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
